fichas.title: Delivery shapes of model panes
fichas.summary: Model panes are specified by sketches and dimensions. Acute angles below 30° require a blunt edge of at least 10 mm. Small panes with edge lengths of 60 cm or less should be avoided because they are more prone to breakage and edge-seal leakage.
uses: Describing and specifying shaped glass panes

fichas.title: Insulated glazing: thermal performance and integrated systems
fichas.summary: Insulated glazing can incorporate light-deflection and solar-control systems, transparent thermal insulation, and self-cleaning coatings. Thermally improved spacers raise room-side surface temperatures at the glass-to-frame transition and reduce condensation risk. The pane cavity width depends on construction; integrated blinds and light-control elements are protected between panes, and panes on both sides of such systems must be toughened glass.
uses: Reducing condensation at the glass-frame transition

dimensions.ocr_raw: The width of the space between the panes varies from 20 to 27 mm according to construction.
